fields.type: (SourceEqualityMkEdgeAllocation.check stored original.guard children.length before).1 = .ok (SourceEqualityMkEdgeAllocation.accepted (SourceEqualityAccessorAllocation.constraint stored original.guard) children.length)

fields.name: rootBounds
fields.type: ∀ paths ∈ classes, ∀ path ∈ paths, match path with | [] => True | first :: _ => first < children.length

fields.type: SourceEqualityMkEdgeAllocation.build symbol stored original.guard children before heap = (.ok actualBuilt.1, (SourceEqualityMkEdgeAllocation.check stored original.guard children.length before).2, actualBuilt.2)

fields.name: projected
fields.type: SourcePruningEnumerationConstraint.project original = some (EnumerationEquality.readClasses classes, if (SourceCompactGuards.positive original.guard).isSome then none else some original)

fields.name: pathReadback
fields.type: ∀ paths ∈ classes, ∀ path, path ∈ EqualityTrie.fromPathTrie (EnumerationEquality.classTrie paths) ↔ path ∈ paths

fields.name: _meaning
fields.type: ∀ (formulas : SourceGuards.Formulas FullSyntax.Formula) (solver : SourceGuards.Entailment FullSyntax.Formula) (term : Language.Term (SourceObservations.Label FullSyntax.Formula)), SourceEqualityPCSGuard.holds formulas solver original term = true ↔ (∀ trie ∈ EnumerationEquality.readClasses classes, EnumerationCorrectness.EqualityHolds term trie) ∧ EnumerationCorrectness.ResidualHolds (fun complete candidate => SourceEqualityPCSGuard.holds formulas solver complete candidate = true) (if (SourceCompactGuards.positive original.guard).isSome then none else some original) term

note: Every returned proof field is inventoried, including unused semantic and receipt fields. No semantic term/satisfaction input or desired arity output is assumed.
